title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
method_summary: Benchmarks professional engineering agents across CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and DCC using artifact-centric domain verifiers.

title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
method_summary: Introduces FunCAD-Harness and FunCADBench to verify generated mechanisms through candidate-specific physical simulation tests.

title: AgenticCADedit: A Stateful, Tool-Mediated Agentic Approach to Multimodal 3D CAD Editing
method_summary: Edits persistent CAD state through incremental actions with geometry inspection, highlighted selections, and operation-level rollback.

title: ConCAD: Constraint-Aware Image-to-CAD Generation with Dual-Granularity Rewards
method_summary: Combines code-level constraint and execution-level geometry rewards for image-to-CAD generation with analytic B-rep constraint evaluation.

title: DrawingsDreamer: A Unified Multi-View Engineering Drawings Generation Model
method_summary: Generates multi-view vector engineering drawings with hierarchical tokenization that preserves local geometry and view alignment.

title: Vision2CAD: A Visual Agent Harness for Explicit Geometry Referencing and Localization in Parametric CAD Modeling
method_summary: Combines visual reasoning with ID-based geometry selection, coordinate conversion, and deterministic CAD kernel operations.

title: DepthBenchCAD: When Does Deeper Auditing Yield More Reliable Conclusions?
method_summary: Analyzes how task coverage, independent generations, and parameter-edit audit depth affect CAD evaluation reliability under fixed budgets.
